mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_financial_profile( user_id, annual_income, income_type, employment_status, credit_score, liquid_asset_amount ) VALUES( #{userId}, #{annualIncome}, #{incomeType}, #{employmentStatus}, #{creditScore}, #{liquidAssetAmount} )
mapper.update: UPDATE user_financial_profile SET annual_income = #{annualIncome}, income_type= #{incomeType}, employment_status= #{employmentStatus}, credit_score= #{creditScore}, liquid_asset_amount= #{liquidAssetAmount} WHERE user_id = #{userId}
